scenarios.name: Preserve a hidden panel when changing ribbon docking position

scenario_steps.name: the 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top with Modify visible
the user hides Modify through Show Panels
the Modify panel disappears from the ribbon
the user docks the ribbon on the left
the ribbon is docked on the left
the user opens Show Panels on the left-docked ribbon
the Modify group returns to the left-docked ribbon
